description: This file contains the implementation of InvokableObjectManager class in Orleans, responsible for managing invokable objects, dispatching messages, handling message processing asynchronously, and managing object lifecycle within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: InvokableObjectManager
classes.description: Manages invokable objects, dispatches messages, and handles object lifecycle within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: InvokableObjectManager.LocalObjectData
classes.description: Represents data associated with a local invokable object, including message queue and message processing logic.

methods.name: InvokableObjectManager.TryRegister
methods.description: Attempts to register an object with a specific ObserverGrainId.

methods.name: InvokableObjectManager.TryDeregister
methods.description: Attempts to deregister an object with a specific ObserverGrainId.

methods.name: InvokableObjectManager.Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a message to the appropriate local object based on the target grain ID.

methods.name: InvokableObjectManager.Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the InvokableObjectManager, cancelling ongoing operations.

methods.name: InvokableObjectManager.LocalObjectData.ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message and enqueues it for processing, starting the message pump if necessary.

methods.name: InvokableObjectManager.LocalObjectData.LocalObjectMessagePumpAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes messages from the queue, invoking methods and handling responses.

methods.name: InvokableObjectManager.LocalObjectData.SendResponseAsync
methods.description: Sends a response message after processing a request.

methods.name: InvokableObjectManager.LocalObjectData.ReportException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during message processing and sends error responses.
